newsitem.title: DENMARK: More gains ahead for Danish shares after record.
newsitem.headline: More gains ahead for Danish shares after record.

text.p: Danish share prices finished off on Thursday at a new all-time closing high, for the third tIme in a week with dealers seeing more record gains ahead.
"The market undertone is still positive, so I see the KFX index going on up tomorrow to hit new record heights," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed 0.49 point higher at 170.76 in overall bourse turnover of 1.143 billion crowns. The last record closing high was Monday's 170.40. The KFX June future rose 0.70 point to 171.50 with 373 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

BG Bank was the most traded paper of the day with 165,780 shares changing hands, attracting interest on mortgage credit firm Nykredit's expected decision on whether or not to stay in BG's bank-insurance-credit pact.
BG Bank closed three crowns up at 325.
Danisco, boosted by buy recommendations and with its full year 1996/97 result due in a fortnight, climbed 10 crowns to its highest ever 414 crowns. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
